title: porter test scenario
description: Version-independent scenario (YAML). References ids from the IR, never version-specific classes. Each step is an object with exactly one key (the step type).

world.description: World preset. Well-known: flat-void (void world, all blocks placed by steps), flat (superflat).

side.description: client = needs a rendering client (GUI checks).

maxTicks.description: Hard timeout in game ticks; runner fails the scenario with status timeout beyond it.

tolerance.description: Comparison tolerances for traces, by sample key or key prefix ('*' = default). Numeric values match if |a-b| <= abs or |a-b| <= rel*max(|a|,|b|); tickShift allows samples to be matched within ±N ticks.

keyMap.description: Per platform version: sample key in that version -> canonical key used for comparison (e.g. NBT keys renamed between versions).

captureName.description: Name of a GUI capture (RFC 005); captures with the same name are compared across versions.

rect.description: [x, y, width, height] in GUI pixels relative to the GUI's top-left corner.

guiCheck.description: RFC 005: how a GUI capture is checked. Coordinates are GUI pixels relative to the GUI's top-left corner.

mode.description: diff = structural diff + image diff against the other version's capture of the same name; structural = this version alone (renders without errors, non-empty, texts fit, expected texts present); absent = no screen may open.

size.description: [width, height] of the GUI area of screens without a container rectangle (centred on the screen).

mask.description: Regions excluded from the image diff (besides the automatic text and slot masks).

textBoxes.description: Every drawn text must lie inside one of these regions (default: the GUI area).

texts.description: Lang keys whose translated text must be drawn (format arguments match anything).

dynamicFrom.description: Earlier capture of the same screen: the regions that changed since then are the GUI's dynamic indicators (bars, gauges, progress) and are compared between versions.

pixelThreshold.description: Per-pixel colour difference (0..1) above which a pixel differs (default 0.1).

maxDiff.description: Largest share of differing unmasked pixels that is still an acceptable diff (default 0.1).

sampleKey.description: Probe expression '<probe>[:<target>][/<path>]', e.g. nbt:[1,65,0]/BurnTime, energy_out:[1,65,4], item:[0,64,0]#2, block:[0,64,0]. Probe vocabulary is owned by testkit (testkit/README.md).

id.description: multiblock node id from the IR.

at.description: World position of the structure's min corner.

interact.description: Fake player right-clicks a block, optionally holding an item.

open_gui.description: Open the GUI of the block at a position (real right-click by the client player) or of an item (held and used), capture it (framebuffer + structure: slots, texts) and dump its structure into the trace. Requires side = client.

item.description: Item to hold and use (item GUIs such as books) instead of clicking a block (RFC 005).

menu.description: Expected menu node id from the IR.

keepOpen.description: Leave the screen open for gui_input steps and for steps that change the block's state (RFC 005).

gui_input.description: RFC 005: input on the open screen (click, key or call), then an optional capture. Without input it only captures, e.g. after steps that changed the block's state.

click.description: [x, y] relative to the GUI's top-left corner.

key.description: Key name of the platform's input library (RIGHT, HOME, ESCAPE, ...).

call.description: Test hook: invoke a public method of the screen object with string/integer/boolean arguments.

every.description: Sample every N ticks during the following tick steps; omitted = sample once now.

expr.description: Boolean expression over the latest sampled values, e.g. 'energy_out > 0'.
